title: Build an AI Agent From Scratch in Python
description: Learn how the agentic loop works by building an AI agent from scratch in Python, with conversation context and tool calling in about 90 lines of code.
summary: You know how LLMs work, and you may already use AI agents to help you write code. However, an agent isn’t an LLM, and an LLM isn’t an agent.
takeaways: In this video course, you’ll build an AI agent from scratch in Python by writing the harness that turns a language model into an agent.
By the end of this video course, you’ll understand that: An AI agent is a language model wrapped in a harness , which is a loop that passes information between you, the model, and a set of tools.
In Real Python’s Build an AI Agent From Scratch in Python live course, you write the loop by hand, then recognize every piece of it in the agents you already use, like Claude Code.
